members.name: Barrister Abeng Roland
members.imageAlt: Portrait of Barrister Abeng Roland, Managing Partner of The Abeng Law Firm
bio: Barrister Abeng Roland founded The Abeng Law Firm in 1998 in Douala, Cameroon, and has led the Firm as Managing Partner since its inception.

Under his leadership, the Firm has built a practice centered on OHADA and Cameroonian business law, and has represented the Firm within international networks including TagLaw and TRACE. The Firm is also ranked in Chambers Global.
members.practiceAreasNote: Leads the Firm's practice across its core business law areas, with particular focus on Corporate, Commercial & OHADA Law.
